tiebreakers.description: If tied on leader tokens and each tied player has exactly one token: ignore the caste you lead and compare captured pieces of the other two castes; most wins.
Still tied: most captured pieces of all castes (including the led caste).
Still tied: tied players share the win.

notes: family: area-majority. Score value = number of caste leader tokens (0-3). If nobody holds any leader token, the player with the most captured pieces overall wins (ties share). Game ends when a caste has no pieces left on the board or 4 pieces have been removed unclaimed (tied captures). Tiebreaks use piece counts that are not derivable from the leader-token score alone, so the scorer must apply them manually. Slug says 'The Legend of Xiandao' but bggId 3 identifies Knizia's Samurai (1998); rules checked against the 2015 Fantasy Flight edition.
